title: Guard Your Heart
question: Why is the heart the thing to guard above all else?
blurb: Proverbs says everything flows from one spring. See what Jesus said flows out of it.

nodes.content: Why is the heart the thing to guard above all else?

nodes.verseText: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.

The good man brings good things out of the good treasure of his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil treasure of his heart. For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.

Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
